name: Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund
oneLiner: JAAA is Janus Henderson's actively managed AAA CLO fund, tokenized through Anemoy/Centrifuge as a permissioned NAV-accreting fund share rather than a $1 token.
collateral: Actively managed AAA-rated CLO tranche portfolio selected by Janus Henderson and tokenized through Anemoy / Centrifuge fund rails.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting fund share rather than a fixed $1 token; subscriptions and redemptions are processed through permissioned Anemoy / Centrifuge primary-market rails at fund NAV.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: JAAA is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: JAAA represents fund shares issued by the Janus Henderson/Anemoy/Centrifuge tokenization stack. The reviewed sources support tokenized fund issuance rather than a user-facing external bridge route, so the multichain posture is treated as issuer-native at probable confidence.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20)

routes.reviewNote: Native JAAA issuance on ethereum: wards() of the JAAA token returns 1 for the Centrifuge V3 Root, BalanceSheet and Spoke contracts (the same CREATE2 addresses as the reviewed Ethereum deployment), so mint authority is the Centrifuge issuer stack (verified on-chain 2026-07-20).

Native JAAA issuance on base: wards() of the JAAA token returns 1 for the Centrifuge V3 Root, BalanceSheet and Spoke contracts (the same CREATE2 addresses as the reviewed Ethereum deployment), so mint authority is the Centrifuge issuer stack (verified on-chain 2026-07-20).

Native JAAA issuance on bsc: wards() of the JAAA token returns 1 for the Centrifuge V3 Root, BalanceSheet and Spoke contracts (the same CREATE2 addresses as the reviewed Ethereum deployment), so mint authority is the Centrifuge issuer stack (verified on-chain 2026-07-20).

Native JAAA issuance on avalanche: wards() of the JAAA token returns 1 for the Centrifuge V3 Root, BalanceSheet and Spoke contracts (the same CREATE2 addresses as the reviewed Ethereum deployment), so mint authority is the Centrifuge issuer stack (verified on-chain 2026-07-20).

Native JAAA issuance on monad: wards() of the JAAA token returns 1 for the Centrifuge V3 Root, BalanceSheet and Spoke contracts (the same CREATE2 addresses as the reviewed Ethereum deployment; Root ward is 0 on Monad with Spoke/BalanceSheet still wards), so mint authority is the Centrifuge issuer stack (verified on-chain 2026-07-20).

Native JAAA issuance on solana: the Token-2022 mint's authority is the issuer keypair BUo4FKP1hSAZ1zcNGzJHTS1V9zcQM8fzUFpYj1NboRK4 (a plain funded signer account, not a bridge program) (verified on-chain 2026-07-20).

notices.title: Contract-priced fund token
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live price and market cap but little or no secondary-market volume; Pharos treats JAAA as a NAV-priced fund share, not a liquid stablecoin peg.

notices.title: Deployment-control semantics remain bounded
notices.message: SONG Safety Score V9 deployment-control review on 2026-07-15 verified the Centrifuge ward and 4-of-9 Safe authority path from issuer, protocol, and Safe sources, but did not establish complete current cap, incident, economic-loss, and materiality reconciliation across all mint surfaces.

mintAuthority.summary: JAAA is a non-upgradeable Centrifuge Tranche token using a ward-based auth system. Active wards are the Root contract (0x7Ed48C31f2fdC40d37407cBaBf0870B2b688368f), BalanceSheet (0x12a110cE5f0FC871cC72Bc7ECaF35cf39DD0f43e), and Spoke (0xEC3582fcDc34078a4B7a8c75a5a3AE46f48525aB). No direct EOA ward access. The Root's ProtocolGuardian delegates to a Centrifuge protocol 4-of-9 Gnosis Safe (0x9711730060C73Ee7Fcfe1890e8A0993858a7D225). Minting gated by BalanceSheet/manager approval of subscriptions at fund NAV.

controls.label: Centrifuge Root contract (top-level ward admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,296,225, the JAAA Tranche token wards are: Root (0x7Ed48C31f2fdC40d37407cBaBf0870B2b688368f, contract), BalanceSheet (0x12a110cE5f0FC871cC72Bc7ECaF35cf39DD0f43e, contract), Spoke (0xEC3582fcDc34078a4B7a8c75a5a3AE46f48525aB, contract). No EOA has direct ward access. Root's ProtocolGuardian (0xCEb7eD5d5B3bAD3088f6A1697738B60d829635c6) routes to the Centrifuge protocol Safe.

controls.label: Centrifuge protocol Gnosis Safe (4-of-9)
controls.evidence: Safe API at Ethereum block 25,296,225: Safe 0x9711730060C73Ee7Fcfe1890e8A0993858a7D225, threshold 4-of-9, version 1.4.1, no modules, no guard. Root's ProtocolGuardian has onlySafe modifier routing control to this Safe.

controls.label: Anemoy / Janus Henderson issuer rail
controls.evidence: Anemoy operates the permissioned primary-market rail for JAAA on Centrifuge; subscriptions/redemptions process at fund NAV through issuer-gated, KYC-restricted access. Actual on-chain minting executed by BalanceSheet ward after manager approval.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,296,225: JAAA Tranche is non-upgradeable, ward-based. Active wards: Root (0x7Ed48C31f2fdC40d37407cBaBf0870B2b688368f), BalanceSheet (0x12a110cE5f0FC871cC72Bc7ECaF35cf39DD0f43e), Spoke (0xEC3582fcDc34078a4B7a8c75a5a3AE46f48525aB). Protocol guardian routes to Centrifuge 4-of-9 Safe (0x9711730060C73Ee7Fcfe1890e8A0993858a7D225, v1.4.1, no modules). Full mint surface confirmed on Ethereum; cross-chain deployments follow same Centrifuge ward pattern.
